options: Build a new form first — lead with the first-form guide and editor resources.
Move existing forms first — lead with importing and reviewing drafts.
Evaluate Tally first — lead with pricing, plan differences, and policies before tutorials.
question.question: Which starting path should this guide emphasize first?
question.rationale: Leading with a first-form tutorial would favor new builds; leading with import would serve people bringing existing forms; leading with pricing would serve people evaluating Tally before building. The draft provisionally includes all three.

simulated_owner_answer: Move existing forms first — lead with importing and reviewing drafts.
